Nemohla ísť do kina v piatok.

theme: describing the weather yesterday and tomorrow

sentences.en: What day is the weather forecast for?
sentences.sk: Na ktorý deň je predpoveď počasia?
altSk: Na aký deň je predpoveď počasia?
sentences.hint: Use 'na + accusative' for day expressions; 'ktorý' agrees with 'deň' (masc.)

sentences.en: Yesterday we ate lunch outside in the sun.
sentences.sk: Včera sme jedli obed vonku na slnku.
altSk: Včera sme jedli obed vonku na slnku.
sentences.hint: 'jesť' in past: jedol/jedla/jedli; use auxiliary 'sme' for 'we'

sentences.en: Do you know if it will rain tomorrow?
sentences.hint: 'vedieť' present: viem/vieš/vie; 'bude pršať' = future with imperfective infinitive

sentences.en: The temperature changed between morning and evening yesterday.
sentences.sk: Včera sa teplota zmenila medzi ránom a večerom.
altSk: Teplota sa včera zmenila medzi ránom a večerom.
Včera sa teplota zmenila od rána do večera.
Teplota sa včera zmenila od rána do večera.
sentences.hint: 'medzi + instrumental': ráno→ránom, večer→večerom; perfective 'zmeniť sa' for completed past

sentences.en: We talked about the menu.
sentences.sk: Rozprávali sme sa o jedálnom lístku.
sentences.hint: o + locative: jedálny lístok → jedálnom lístku

sentences.en: The waiter brought us the soup.
sentences.hint: past tense of priniesť: priniesol (irregular)

sentences.en: I would like five glasses of water, please.
altSk: Chcel by som päť pohárov vody.
Chcela by som päť pohárov vody.
sentences.hint: päť + genitive plural: pohár → pohárov

sentences.en: Is this your table or my table?
sentences.sk: Je to tvoj stôl alebo môj stôl?
altSk: Je to tvoj stolík alebo môj stolík?
sentences.hint: possessives: tvoj/môj agree with masculine noun stôl

theme: describing the weather yesterday and tomorrow

sentences.en: It was raining yesterday.
sentences.hint: Use the impersonal verb 'pršať' — no subject needed in Slovak

sentences.en: The weather changed itself completely today.
sentences.hint: Reflexive verb 'zmeniť sa' — place 'sa' after the first stressed word

sentences.en: At what time does the storm arrive tomorrow?
sentences.hint: Use 'o koľkej' for asking at what time; 'príde' is perfective present used as future

sentences.en: My father drove to the mountains by car yesterday.
sentences.sk: Môj otec včera išiel do hôr autom.
altSk: Včera môj otec išiel autom do hôr.
sentences.hint: 'Autom' is instrumental of 'auto' — no preposition needed for means of transport; 'otca' would be accusative if he were the object, but here he is the subject

sentences.en: Do you know where my parents are?
altSk: Vieš, kde sa nachádzajú moji rodičia?
Viete, kde sa nachádzajú moji rodičia?
sentences.hint: vedieť: viem, vieš, vie, vieme, viete, vedia

sentences.en: I see my grandma between the trees.
sentences.sk: Vidím svoju starú mamu medzi stromami.
sentences.hint: medzi + instrumental plural: stromami

sentences.en: Dad ate a big lunch on Saturday.
sentences.sk: Otec jedol veľký obed v sobotu.
altSk: Tatko jedol veľký obed v sobotu.
sentences.hint: jesť → jedol (irregular past tense, masculine)

sentences.en: Our family picnic is on the fifth of June.
sentences.sk: Náš rodinný piknik je piateho júna.
sentences.hint: date: ordinal in genitive — piaty → piateho, jún → júna

theme: at the bank or post office

sentences.en: I went to the post office yesterday.
sentences.hint: išiel/išla is the irregular past tense of ísť

sentences.en: You must fill in this form.
sentences.hint: musieť + infinitive expresses obligation

sentences.en: I will send the package tomorrow.
sentences.hint: pošlem is the perfective present of poslať, used as future

sentences.en: I never have any money at the bank.
sentences.sk: Nikdy nemám žiadne peniaze v banke.
altSk: Ja nikdy nemám žiadne peniaze v banke.
sentences.hint: use nikdy + nemám + žiadne — Slovak requires all negatives together

sentences.en: I am at the restaurant today.
sentences.hint: Use 'som' for I am; reštaurácia → locative: reštaurácii

sentences.en: The Italian waiter is very friendly.
altSk: Čašník je veľmi priateľský a taliansky.
sentences.hint: Italian (adjective) = taliansky; agrees with masculine noun čašník

sentences.en: Where are you from, miss?
sentences.hint: Use 'odkiaľ' for 'where from'; ste = formal you are, si = informal

sentences.en: Peter's menu is on the table.
sentences.sk: Petrov jedálny lístok je na stole.
sentences.hint: Possessive from male name Peter → Petrov; stôl → locative: stole

sentences.en: The doctor has a white coat.
sentences.hint: biely (white) agrees with plášť (masc. inanimate accusative = nominative form)

sentences.en: Can the teacher explain this now?
sentences.hint: môže = 3rd person singular of môcť; infinitive at end

sentences.en: She works through the night for her patients.
sentences.sk: Pracuje cez noc pre svojich pacientov.
altSk: Ona pracuje cez noc pre pacientov.
sentences.hint: cez + accusative (noc), pre + accusative (pacientov)

sentences.en: Where does the chef go every morning?
sentences.hint: ísť present: idem/ideš/ide/ideme/idete/idú — irregular stem

sentences.en: What do you know about my brother?
altSk: Čo ty vieš o mojom bratovi?
sentences.hint: o + locative: brat → bratovi

sentences.en: She had long brown hair.
sentences.hint: past tense of mať: mala (feminine)

sentences.en: My friend has five good colleagues.
sentences.sk: Môj priateľ má päť dobrých kolegov.
altSk: Môj kamarát má päť dobrých kolegov.
sentences.hint: päť + genitive plural: dobrých kolegov

sentences.en: Is your sister taller than your brother?
sentences.sk: Je tvoja sestra vyššia ako tvoj brat?
altSk: Tvoja sestra je vyššia ako tvoj brat?
sentences.hint: tvoja (fem. nom.) vs. tvoj (masc. nom.)

theme: telling the time and making appointments

sentences.en: The meeting is at three o'clock.
sentences.hint: Use 'je' for singular subject; time after 'o' takes locative

Je ten doktor Slovák alebo Maďar?
sentences.hint: Nationality as noun/adjective; 'je' for yes/no question with rising intonation

sentences.en: Where is Marta's appointment today?
sentences.hint: Female name Marta → possessive 'Martino' (neuter noun); word order flexible

sentences.en: Where are you calling from for the appointment?
sentences.hint: 'Odkiaľ' = from where; use formal 'voláte' (vy-form); 'termín' in genitive after 'kvôli'

sentences.en: We talked about the timetable.
sentences.hint: Use 'o' with locative case: rozvrh → rozvrhu

sentences.en: Yesterday I studied for my exam.
sentences.sk: Včera som sa učil na skúšku.
sentences.hint: Past tense: učiť sa → učil som sa (masc.) / učila som sa (fem.)

sentences.en: I have five lectures this week.
sentences.hint: After 5+, use genitive plural: prednáška → prednášok

sentences.hint: Possessive adjective môj agrees with masculine noun: môj rozvrh

sentences.en: Can you hear me well?
sentences.hint: 'me' is the direct object — use accusative: mňa/ma

Rozprávam sa s mamičkou po telefóne.
sentences.hint: 'with' uses instrumental case: s + mamou

sentences.hint: Double negation: ne- on verb + nijaký/žiadny before noun

sentences.en: She carried the heavy bag to the car.
sentences.hint: niesť → niesol/niesla (irregular past tense)

Zajtra ráno si poprosím o pomoc.
sentences.hint: Use perfective present (požiadam/poprosím) for future meaning

sentences.hint: pri + locative: okno → okne

sentences.hint: past tense of môcť (feminine): mohla → nemohla + infinitive

sentences.hint: priatelia is the nominative plural of priateľ. Adjectives in nom. pl. masculine animate end in -í.

Zájdem s tebou na autobusovú zastávku.

sentences.hint: Za + instrumental case: starý kostol → za starým kostolom

sentences.hint: O ňom = about it/him, locative pronoun referring to a masculine noun (kostol, park etc.)

Dnes je zima, ale zajtra bude svietiť slnko.

Chcela by som minerálnu vodu, prosím.
sentences.hint: chcieť is irregular: chcem, chceš, chce... Use accusative after chcieť.

sentences.hint: niesť → doniesť (perfective); doniesol = past tense masc. sg. The prefix do-/pri- makes it perfective, showing the action was completed.

sentences.hint: blue (modrý) must agree with pohovka (fem.) in accusative: modrú pohovku

Môžem sa pozrieť na celý apartmán?

Kúpila som nové závesy do spálne.

sentences.hint: 'už' + past tense in a question; 'priateľa' and 'Petra' are accusative

Ešte som sa neprechádzal po starom meste.
sentences.hint: 'ešte ne-' for not yet; 'po starom meste' uses locative case after 'po'

theme: describing furniture and rooms in a flat

sentences.hint: 'jesť' is irregular: jem, ješ, je, jeme, jete, jedia

sentences.hint: stáť is irregular: stojím, stojíš, stojí

sentences.en: The bus stop is three stops away.
sentences.hint: 2-4 + nominative plural: dve/tri/štyri zastávky

theme: describing the weather yesterday and tomorrow

sentences.hint: 'o počasí' uses locative case (o + locative); počasie → počasí

sentences.en: I will introduce myself to you tomorrow.
sentences.hint: Use perfective present of 'predstaviť sa' for future meaning, or 'budem sa predstavovať'

sentences.en: Do you know something about her nationality?
sentences.hint: 'about her' = 'o nej' (locative pronoun), but here 'jej' modifies the noun

sentences.en: She is standing right in front of the map of Slovakia.
altSk: Ona stojí priamo pred mapou Slovenska.
Ona stojí hneď pred mapou Slovenska.
sentences.hint: 'in front of' = 'pred' + instrumental case of 'mapa' → 'mapou'

sentences.en: Where did you go after you introduced yourself?
sentences.sk: Kam si išiel po tom, ako si sa predstavil?
altSk: Kam si išla po tom, ako si sa predstavila?
Kam ste išli potom, čo ste sa predstavili?
sentences.hint: Irregular past of 'ísť': išiel (masc.) / išla (fem.); remember gender agreement

sentences.en: Do you know when her birthday is?
sentences.hint: vedieť takes no object here; use 2nd person sg 'vieš'

sentences.en: His birthday is on the fifth of May.
sentences.hint: dates use genitive: piaty → piateho, máj → mája

sentences.en: He ate the whole birthday cake himself.
altSk: Zjedol celú narodeninovú tortu celý sám.
On zjedol celú narodeninovú tortu sám.
sentences.hint: jesť → zjedol (perfective past, masculine); celú = accusative feminine

sentences.en: I see many candles among the flowers on the table.
sentences.sk: Vidím veľa sviečok medzi kvetmi na stole.
altSk: Vidím sviečky medzi kvetmi na stole.
sentences.hint: medzi + instrumental plural: kvety → kvetmi; vidieť uses present stem vidím

sentences.en: The ticket costs twenty euros.
sentences.hint: stáť uses stojí in 3rd person singular present

sentences.en: I am a pilot and I travel often.
altSk: Ja som pilot a cestujem často.
Ja som pilot a často cestujem.
sentences.hint: professions after byť use nominative, no article needed

sentences.en: We need trousers for the trip.
sentences.hint: nohavice is pluralia tantum — always plural, no singular form

sentences.en: Three friends are buying tickets today.
sentences.hint: 2–4 + nominative plural (traja priatelia), not genitive singular

sentences.en: The students are sitting in the lecture hall.
sentences.hint: nominative plural: študenti (masc animate -i)

sentences.en: I want to change my schedule this semester.
sentences.sk: Chcem zmeniť môj rozvrh tento semester.
altSk: Chcem zmeniť svoj rozvrh tento semester.
Chcem zmeniť môj rozvrh v tomto semestri.
Chcem zmeniť svoj rozvrh v tomto semestri.
sentences.hint: chcieť + infinitive; zmeniť is perfective

sentences.en: Do you have a mathematics lecture today?
sentences.hint: prednášku = accusative feminine singular (-a → -u)

sentences.en: She was writing notes and then she wrote everything down.
sentences.sk: Písala si poznámky a potom si všetko zapísala.
altSk: Písala poznámky a potom zapísala všetko.
sentences.hint: písať (impf, ongoing) → zapísať (pf, completed action); reflexive si optional with písať

sentences.en: The summer holidays are starting tomorrow.
sentences.hint: Use 'začínať sa' (to begin) – reflexive verb with 'sa'. Present tense.

sentences.en: It is half past ten in the morning.
sentences.hint: 'Half past ten' = pol jedenástej (half of eleven). Add 'dopoludnia' for AM.

sentences.en: Have you already bought a ticket for the trip?
sentences.sk: Už si kúpil lístok na výlet?
altSk: Už ste si kúpili lístok na výlet?
sentences.hint: 'Už' + past tense for 'already done'. Use perfective 'kúpiť' → 'kúpil'.

sentences.en: We have not swum in the sea yet.
altSk: Ešte sme sa nekúpali v mori.
My sme ešte neplávali v mori.
My sme ešte neplavali v mori.
Ešte sme sa v mori nekúpali.
sentences.hint: 'Ešte ne-' + past for 'not yet'. 'More' → locative 'mori'. Double negation applies.
sentences.focus: ešte ne- + past negative / locative po + noun

sentences.en: My apartment costs four hundred euros.
sentences.sk: Môj byt stojí štyri sto eur.
altSk: Môj byt stojí štyri sto EUR.
sentences.hint: stáť (to cost) conjugates as stojím, stojíš, stojí — use stojí for on/ona/ono

sentences.en: I am an architect and I work from home.
sentences.sk: Som architekt a pracujem z domu.
altSk: Som architektka a pracujem z domu.
sentences.hint: In Slovak, professions after 'som' do NOT need an article; use nominative sg

sentences.en: My apartment has three large rooms.
sentences.sk: Môj byt má tri veľké izby.
altSk: V mojom byte sú tri veľké izby.
Môj byt má tri priestranné izby.
sentences.hint: 2-4 + nominative plural (izby, not izieb); adjective agrees: veľké (nom pl)

sentences.en: I don't have scissors anywhere in the apartment.
sentences.hint: nožnice is pluralia tantum — it only exists in plural form; use double negation: nemám + nikde

theme: describing the weather yesterday and tomorrow

sentences.en: The clouds covered the sun yesterday.
sentences.hint: Use zakryť (perfective) to show a completed action in the past.

sentences.en: I want a warm day tomorrow.
altSk: Chcem, aby zajtra bol teplý deň.
sentences.hint: chcieť is followed by a noun (accusative) here, not an infinitive — but the modal form of chcieť is still practised.

sentences.en: Did you see the big storm yesterday?
sentences.hint: búrka is a feminine noun; use the accusative ending -u on both the adjective (veľkú) and the noun (búrku).

sentences.en: The days will be long and sunny tomorrow.
sentences.sk: Dni budú dlhé a slnečné zajtra.
altSk: Zajtra budú dni dlhé a slnečné.
Zajtra dni budú dlhé a slnečné.
sentences.hint: Dni is the nominative plural of deň (irregular); adjectives also take plural endings: dlhé, slnečné.
sentences.focus: nominative plural: deň → dni, dlhý → dlhé, slnečný → slnečné

sentences.en: I am enjoying myself at the cinema.
sentences.hint: Reflexive verbs use 'sa' after the verb

sentences.en: At what time does the film start?
altSk: O ktorej hodine sa začína film?
O koľkej hodine sa začína film?
sentences.hint: Use 'o koľkej' for asking at what time

sentences.en: Do you know the main actor in this film?
sentences.sk: Poznáš hlavného herca v tomto filme?
altSk: Poznáte hlavného herca v tomto filme?
Vieš, kto je hlavný herec v tomto filme?
Viete, kto je hlavný herec v tomto filme?
Poznáš hlavného herca z tohto filmu?
Poznáte hlavného herca z tohto filmu?
sentences.hint: Animate masculine nouns take -a ending in accusative

sentences.en: We went to the cinema by tram yesterday.
sentences.sk: Včera sme išli do kina električkou.
altSk: Šli sme včera do kina električkou.
Včera sme šli do kina električkou.
sentences.hint: Use instrumental case (no preposition) for means of transport

sentences.en: Where is my toothbrush?
altSk: Kde je moja kefka na zuby?
sentences.hint: môj/moja agrees with feminine noun zubná kefka

sentences.en: We talked about our morning routine.
sentences.sk: Rozprávali sme sa o rannej rutine.
altSk: Rozprávali sme sa o našej rannej rutine.
Hovorili sme o našej rannej rutine.
sentences.hint: o + locative: ranná rutina → rannej rutine

sentences.en: She drank two cups of coffee this morning.
sentences.sk: Dnes ráno vypila dve šálky kávy.
altSk: Dnes ráno ona vypila dve šálky kávy.
sentences.hint: past tense feminine: vypila (perfective); šálky is genitive plural after dve

sentences.en: I need five more minutes every morning.
sentences.sk: Každé ráno potrebujem päť minút navyše.
altSk: Každé ráno potrebujem ešte päť minút.
sentences.hint: päť + genitive plural: minuta → minút

theme: telling the time and making appointments

sentences.en: We will meet at the café.
sentences.hint: Use 'pri' with locative case for 'at/by a place'. Kaviareň → pri kaviarni.

sentences.en: The appointment is at three o'clock.
sentences.hint: Use ordinal number in locative with 'o' for clock times. Tri → tretej.

sentences.en: Shall we meet on Friday morning?
altSk: Môžeme sa stretnúť v piatok ráno?
Môžeme sa stretnúť v piatok doobeda?
Dáme si stretnutie v piatok ráno?
Čo tak sa stretnúť v piatok ráno?
sentences.hint: 'Stretnúť sa' is a reflexive verb — include 'sa'. Use perfective 'stretneme sa' for a future one-time meeting.

sentences.en: She could not come to the meeting yesterday.
altSk: Ona včera nemohla prísť na stretnutie.
sentences.hint: Past tense of 'môcť' for a female subject: mohla → nemohla. Add 'ne-' for negation.

sentences.en: We are meeting at the café today.
sentences.hint: reflexive verb 'stretávať sa' needs 'sa'; café is locative: kaviarni

sentences.en: At what time are we meeting tomorrow?
sentences.hint: 'o koľkej' = at what time; use perfective 'stretnúť sa' for one-off event

sentences.en: I see my good friend Peter there.
sentences.sk: Vidím tam svojho dobrého priateľa Petra.
altSk: Tam vidím svojho dobrého priateľa Petra.
Vidím tam môjho dobrého priateľa Petra.
Tam vidím môjho dobrého priateľa Petra.
sentences.hint: animate masculine accusative: priateľ→priateľa, Peter→Petra, dobrý→dobrého

sentences.en: My friend came to the party by car.
sentences.sk: Môj priateľ prišiel na párty autom.
sentences.hint: instrument/transport uses bare instrumental, no preposition: auto→autom

sentences.en: I will cook dinner at home today.
sentences.hint: Use 'budem' + infinitive for future tense.

sentences.en: The pot is standing under the shelf.
sentences.hint: 'Pod' triggers the instrumental case — 'polička' becomes 'poličkou'.

sentences.en: We talked about dinner for a long time.
sentences.sk: Dlho sme sa rozprávali o večeri.
altSk: Rozprávali sme sa dlho o večeri.
Dlho sme sa bavili o večeri.
Bavili sme sa dlho o večeri.
sentences.hint: 'O' + locative — 'večera' becomes 'večeri'.

sentences.en: Did Peter go to the shop for the ingredients?
sentences.sk: Išiel Peter do obchodu pre suroviny?
altSk: Šiel Peter do obchodu pre suroviny?
Išiel Peter do obchodu po suroviny?
Šiel Peter do obchodu po suroviny?
Išiel Peter do predajne pre suroviny?
Šiel Peter do predajne pre suroviny?
Išiel Peter do predajne po suroviny?
Šiel Peter do predajne po suroviny?
sentences.hint: Irregular past of 'ísť' — masculine singular is 'išiel' (or 'šiel').

sentences.en: What day is today?
sentences.hint: Use 'ktorý' for 'which' with days
sentences.focus: nominative singular - asking about the day

sentences.en: I want to know today's date.
sentences.hint: chcieť takes infinitive; 'dnešný' is a possessive adjective

sentences.en: On Monday I will write an email.
sentences.hint: Use perfective 'napísať' for a completed future action; present form of perfective = future

sentences.en: What dates are free this week?
sentences.sk: Ktoré dátumy sú voľné tento týždeň?
altSk: Aké dátumy sú voľné tento týždeň?
sentences.hint: 'dátumy' is nominative plural masculine inanimate; adjective 'voľné' agrees in plural
sentences.focus: nominative plural (masculine inanimate noun + adjective agreement)

sentences.en: He went straight and then turned left.
sentences.sk: Išiel rovno a potom odbočil doľava.
altSk: Šiel rovno a potom zabočil doľava.
Išiel priamo a potom odbočil doľava.
Šiel priamo a potom odbočil doľava.
Išiel rovno a potom zabočil doľava.
Šiel rovno a potom odbočil doľava.
Išiel priamo a potom zabočil doľava.
Šiel priamo a potom zabočil doľava.
sentences.hint: ísť → išiel (irregular past tense masculine)

sentences.en: You must turn right at the crossroads.
sentences.hint: musieť: musím, musíš, musí... + infinitive

sentences.en: I will explain the way to you.
sentences.hint: vysvetlím = perfective present acting as future

sentences.en: Nobody told me anything about the stop.
sentences.sk: Nikto mi nič nepovedal o zastávke.
altSk: Nikto mi nič nehovoril o zastávke.
Nikto mi nič nepovedal o tej zastávke.
Nikto mi nič nehovoril o tej zastávke.
Nik mi nič nepovedal o zastávke.
Nik mi nič nehovoril o zastávke.
sentences.hint: nikto + nič + negative verb — double negation is required in Slovak

sentences.en: The lecture already ended.
sentences.hint: Use 'už' with past tense of 'končiť sa' (perfective: skončiť sa → skončila sa)

sentences.en: The film has not started yet.
sentences.hint: Use 'ešte' + negation with past tense of 'začať sa' → nezačal sa

sentences.en: It is half past eight in the morning.
sentences.hint: In Slovak 'half past eight' = 'pol deviatej' (half of the ninth hour)

sentences.en: There are pictures hanging all around the apartment.
altSk: Po celom byte visí veľa obrazov.
sentences.hint: Use 'po' + locative of 'byt' → byte, meaning 'around/throughout the apartment'

sentences.en: My sister is at home today.
sentences.hint: Use 'je' for third person singular of byť

sentences.en: Their grandmother is a Slovak woman.
sentences.hint: Nationality adjective used as noun: Slovenka (Slovak woman)

sentences.en: Where is Peter's car this weekend?
sentences.sk: Kde je Petrovo auto tento víkend?
altSk: Kde je tento víkend Petrovo auto?
sentences.hint: Possessive from male name Peter → Petrov/Petrovo (neuter noun auto)

sentences.en: Where are you from? I am not from Bratislava.
sentences.sk: Odkiaľ si? Nie som z Bratislavy.
altSk: Odkiaľ pochádzaš? Nie som z Bratislavy.
sentences.hint: Use 'odkiaľ' for 'where from'; negate byť with 'nie som'; z + genitive

sentences.en: She wants to call her friend.
sentences.hint: chcieť + infinitive; zavolať is perfective

sentences.en: I hear a woman on the phone.
sentences.hint: žena → ženu in accusative (feminine -u ending)

sentences.en: He finally answered the call.
sentences.hint: zdvihnúť (pf) vs. zdvíhať (impf); completed action

sentences.en: My friends are always on their phones.
sentences.sk: Moji priatelia sú stále pri telefónoch.
altSk: Moji kamaráti sú neustále pri telefónoch.
Moje priateľky sú stále pri telefónoch.
Moji priatelia sú neustále pri telefónoch.
Moji priatelia sú stále na telefónoch.
Moji kamaráti sú stále pri telefónoch.
Moji priatelia neustále hľadia do telefónov.
Moji priatelia sú stále zahľadení do telefónov.
sentences.hint: priateľ → priatelia (masc. animate nominative plural)

theme: telling the time and making appointments

sentences.en: Do you know when the meeting is?
sentences.hint: vedieť is irregular: viem, vieš, vie, vieme, viete, vedia

sentences.en: I ate lunch between twelve and one.
sentences.sk: Jedol som obed medzi dvanástou a jednou.
altSk: Obedoval som medzi dvanástou a jednou.
Jedla som obed medzi dvanástou a jednou.
sentences.hint: jesť→jedol/jedla in past; medzi takes instrumental: dvanástou, jednou

sentences.en: The appointment is between Monday and Wednesday.
sentences.sk: Termín je medzi pondelkom a stredou.
altSk: Stretnutie je medzi pondelkom a stredou.
sentences.hint: medzi + instrumental: pondelkom, stredou (feminine instr. -ou)

sentences.en: The meeting is on the fifth of March at two.
sentences.sk: Stretnutie je piateho marca o druhej.
altSk: Mám stretnutie piateho marca o druhej.
Schôdza je piateho marca o druhej.
sentences.hint: date in genitive: piateho marca; time with o + locative: o druhej

sentences.en: I am eating soup for dinner.
sentences.hint: jesť is irregular: jem, ješ, je, jeme, jete, jedia

sentences.en: She is cooking chicken and vegetables.
sentences.hint: kurča and zeleninu are in accusative as direct objects

sentences.en: He is cooking dinner with his sister.
altSk: On varí večeru so svojou sestrou.
sentences.hint: s/so + instrumental: sestra → sestrou

sentences.en: We are standing in the kitchen and cooking pasta.
sentences.sk: Stojíme v kuchyni a varíme cestoviny.
altSk: V kuchyni stojíme a varíme cestoviny.
Stojíme v kuchyni a pripravujeme cestoviny.
sentences.hint: v + locative: kuchyňa → kuchyni; stáť is irregular: stojím, stojíš...

sentences.en: I want to buy a red dress.
sentences.hint: červené šaty = red dress, accusative plural neuter

sentences.en: Can you come to the party on Saturday?
sentences.sk: Môžeš prísť na párty v sobotu?
altSk: Môžeš prísť na párty v sobotu?
sentences.hint: môžeš = can you (2nd sg), prísť = to come

sentences.en: We are going through the park this weekend.
sentences.hint: cez + accusative = through/across; cez víkend = over the weekend

sentences.en: Where are you going on Sunday morning?
sentences.hint: ideš = you go (irregular ísť, 2nd sg present); kam = where to

sentences.en: Can you help me, please?
sentences.hint: môcť = can/may; 2nd person sg: môžeš

sentences.en: I am looking for a red bag.
sentences.hint: červený → červenú (fem. accusative); taška → tašku

sentences.en: I need this form for my friend.
sentences.sk: Potrebujem tento formulár pre môjho priateľa.
sentences.hint: pre + accusative; priateľ → priateľa (masc. animate accusative)

sentences.en: Where do you go for help?
altSk: Na koho sa obrátiš o pomoc?
sentences.hint: ísť irregular: idem, ideš, ide, ideme, idete, idú; cez/pre + accusative

theme: telling the time and making appointments

sentences.en: I want to make an appointment for tomorrow.
sentences.sk: Chcem si dohodnúť stretnutie na zajtra.
altSk: Chcem si dojednať stretnutie na zajtra.
sentences.hint: chcieť + reflexive infinitive; 'stretnutie' is neuter accusative

sentences.en: He is waiting for a free minute.
sentences.hint: feminine noun 'minúta' takes -u ending in accusative singular; adjective 'voľný' agrees: voľnú

sentences.en: The doctors are already in the waiting room.
sentences.hint: masculine animate nominative plural: lekár → lekári; doktor → doktori

sentences.en: She finally wrote down the appointment time.
altSk: Ona si konečne zapísala čas stretnutia.
Ona si konečne poznačila čas stretnutia.
Ona si konečne zapísala čas schôdzky.
sentences.hint: perfective verb 'zapísať si' (pf.) vs imperfective 'zapisovať si'; completed action in past uses perfective

theme: at the bank or post office

sentences.en: I want to send this package.
sentences.hint: chcieť is irregular: chcem, chceš, chce...

sentences.en: Please fill in this form.
sentences.hint: formulár is masculine, accusative singular = formulár (no change)

sentences.en: I am going to the bank with my friend.
sentences.hint: s + instrumental: priateľ → priateľom

sentences.en: You can exchange money at the post office.
sentences.sk: Môžete si vymeniť peniaze na pošte.
altSk: Môžeš si vymeniť peniaze na pošte.
Môžete si zameniť peniaze na pošte.
Môžeš si zameniť peniaze na pošte.
Peniaze si môžete vymeniť na pošte.
Peniaze si môžeš vymeniť na pošte.
sentences.hint: na pošte = locative of pošta (feminine); pošta → pošte

theme: describing furniture and rooms in a flat

sentences.en: I want to buy a new sofa.
sentences.hint: chcieť + infinitive; 'pohovka' is feminine, accusative ending -u

sentences.en: We are putting the table into the kitchen.
sentences.hint: 'stôl' is masculine inanimate, accusative same as nominative; imperfective aspect (ongoing action)

sentences.en: She cleaned the whole room.
sentences.hint: perfective verb 'upratať' in past tense; 'izba' is feminine, accusative ending -u

sentences.en: The chairs and tables are new here.
sentences.sk: Stoličky a stoly sú tu nové.
altSk: Tu sú stoličky a stoly nové.
sentences.hint: 'stoličky' (f. pl.) and 'stoly' (m. inanimate pl.) in nominative plural; adjective 'nové' agrees in plural

sentences.en: I see grey clouds today.
sentences.hint: sivé oblaky – adjective + noun in accusative plural

sentences.en: We can't go outside because of the rain.
sentences.hint: nemôžeme = we cannot (modal môcť, negated)

sentences.en: They are staying home because of the storm.
sentences.hint: pre búrku – pre + accusative expressing reason

sentences.en: Where are you going in this bad weather?
sentences.sk: Kam ideš v tomto zlom počasí?
altSk: Kam idete v tomto zlom počasí?
Kam ideš za takého zlého počasia?
Kam idete za takého zlého počasia?
Kam ideš v takom zlom počasí?
Kam idete v takom zlom počasí?
sentences.hint: ideš = you go/are going – irregular ísť present tense

sentences.en: I am a student and I live in a dormitory.
sentences.sk: Som študent a bývam na internáte.
altSk: Som študentka a bývam na internáte.
sentences.hint: Use 'som' for 'I am' and locative after 'na' for location

sentences.en: There are three beds in our room.
sentences.sk: V našej izbe sú tri postele.
altSk: V našej izbe sa nachádzajú tri postele.
sentences.hint: 2-4 take nominative plural (postele), not genitive plural

sentences.en: How much does a place in a dormitory cost?
sentences.hint: stáť meaning 'to cost' conjugates as stojím/stojí (irregular present stem)

sentences.en: I don't have any scissors, can I borrow yours?
sentences.sk: Nemám nožnice, môžem si požičať tvoje?
altSk: Nemám nožnice, môžem si zobrať tvoje?
sentences.hint: Nožnice is pluralia tantum — it has no singular form in Slovak

sentences.en: What is the weather like on Friday?
sentences.hint: Use 'aké' for weather questions; 'v piatok' = on Friday (accusative)

sentences.en: I never forget his birthday date.
altSk: Nikdy na jeho dátum narodenín nezabudnem.
Nikdy nezabudnem na jeho dátum narodenín.
sentences.hint: Double negation: 'nikdy' + 'ne-' prefix on verb

sentences.en: Do you know that meeting? I already moved it.
sentences.sk: Poznáš tú schôdzku? Už som ju presunul.
altSk: Vieš o tej schôdzke? Už som ju presunul.
sentences.hint: 'ju' replaces feminine noun 'schôdzku' (accusative pronoun)

sentences.en: On Tuesday I went to the cinema with a friend.
sentences.sk: V utorok som išiel do kina so kamarátom.
altSk: V utorok som šiel do kina so priateľom.
V utorok som išiel do kina s kamarátom.
V utorok som šiel do kina s kamarátom.
V utorok som išla do kina so kamarátom.
V utorok som išla do kina s kamarátom.
V utorok som šla do kina so kamarátom.
V utorok som šla do kina s kamarátom.
V utorok som išiel do kina so priateľom.
V utorok som išiel do kina s priateľom.
V utorok som šiel do kina s priateľom.
sentences.hint: 'so' used before consonant cluster in 'kamarátom'; past tense 'ísť→išiel'

sentences.en: She knows that man very well.
sentences.sk: Ona toho muža veľmi dobre pozná.
altSk: Tá žena toho muža veľmi dobre pozná.
Toho muža veľmi dobre pozná ona.
Ona veľmi dobre pozná toho muža.
sentences.hint: Use 'poznať' (to know a person), present tense conjugation: pozná

sentences.en: I can see a tall woman over there.
sentences.hint: 'vidieť' conjugates: vidím/vidíš/vidí; 'vysokú ženu' is accusative singular feminine

sentences.en: He ate lunch between those two tall men.
sentences.sk: On jedol obed medzi tými dvoma vysokými mužmi.

On jedol obed medzi tými dvomi vysokými mužmi.
Jedol obed medzi dvomi vysokými mužmi.

Obedoval medzi tými dvoma vysokými mužmi.
On obedoval medzi dvoma vysokými mužmi.
sentences.hint: 'jesť→jedol' (past tense irregular); 'medzi' takes instrumental: 'tými dvoma vysokými mužmi'

sentences.en: My sister was born on the fifth of March.
sentences.sk: Moja sestra sa narodila piateho marca.
sentences.hint: Dates use genitive: 'piateho marca' (5th of March); 'narodiť sa' is reflexive, past tense feminine: narodila sa

sentences.en: What do you think about this film?

altSk: Čo si myslíte o tomto filme?
Aký máš názor na tento film?
Aký máte názor na tento film?
sentences.hint: o + locative: film → filme

sentences.en: My sister liked the red dress more.
sentences.sk: Moja sestra mala radšej červené šaty.
altSk: Mojej sestre sa viac páčili červené šaty.
sentences.hint: past tense of mať: mala; radšej = more/preferably

sentences.en: This shop has five kinds of cheese.
sentences.sk: Tento obchod má päť druhov syra.
altSk: V tomto obchode je päť druhov syra.
sentences.hint: päť + genitive plural: druh → druhov, syr → syra

sentences.en: Is your car faster than my car?
sentences.sk: Je tvoje auto rýchlejšie ako moje auto?
altSk: Je tvoj automobil rýchlejší ako môj automobil?
Je tvoje auto rýchlejšie ako moje?
Je tvoj automobil rýchlejší ako môj?
Je tvoje auto rýchlejšie než moje auto?
Je tvoje auto rýchlejšie než moje?
Je tvoj automobil rýchlejší než môj automobil?
Je tvoj automobil rýchlejší než môj?
sentences.hint: tvoje/moje agree with auto (neuter); rýchlejší/rýchlejšie = faster

theme: at the bank or post office

sentences.en: I am at the post office.
sentences.hint: Use 'som' for I am; 'pošta' takes locative: pošte

sentences.en: The American clerk works at the bank.
altSk: Americký bankový úradník pracuje v banke.
sentences.hint: Nationality adjective 'americký' agrees with masculine noun 'úradník'

sentences.en: Where is Peter's account number?
sentences.hint: Possessive from male name Peter → Petrov; 'číslo' is neuter so Petrovo

sentences.en: Where are you from and why are you here at the bank?
sentences.sk: Odkiaľ si a prečo si tu v banke?
altSk: Odkiaľ ste a prečo ste tu v banke?
sentences.hint: 'Odkiaľ' asks about origin; 'kde' asks location; use 'si' for informal or 'ste' for formal
